test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series. 

E_ _CD _ H J _ _ E H _ _ D

options.text: H, E, C, D, C, J, C
H, J, C, E, C, E, H
H, J, E, C, D, J, C
H, C, E, J, D, C, E

solution:
Given sequence: E_ _CD _ H J _ _ E H _ _ D

 
• H, E, C, D, C, J, C → E **H E **C D - **C** H J **D C** - E H **J C** D
 
• H, J, C, E, C, E, H → E H J C D - **C** H J **E** C - E H **E H** D 
 
• H, J, E, C, D, J, C → E **H J** C D - **E** H J **C D** - E H **J C** D 
 
• H, C, E, J, D, C, E → E H C C D - E H J **J** D - E H C E D

 
• In option 3, EHJCD is repeated.

Hence, '**H, J, E, C, D, J, C**' is the correct answer.
